name: Recovered-expression Exp-DeepDEP and PCR comparison
scope: Same-data adaptation with official pair minibatching; not an exact historical-paper reproduction.

inputs.feature_policy: Both PCR and DeepDEP use the exact same recovered matrix; remaining missing positions keep official reference means. No fuzzy mapping or outcome-based feature selection.

inner_selection.grouping: Reuse patient-connected whole-lineage folds from historical benchmark.
inner_selection.metric: Non-common-essential within-model residual NDCG@10, averaged equally by inner heldout lineage.
inner_selection.deep_rule: For each frozen checkpoint, average predictions of three seeds, then score; pool all five inner folds. Select the checkpoint with maximum lineage-equal NDCG; ties choose fewer epochs.
inner_selection.outer_refit: Refit three seeds on all outer training models for the selected epoch count; ensemble predictions.

pcr_ridge.selection: Same five inner folds and NDCG; ties prefer lower rank then higher alpha.

exp_deepdep_absolute_secondary.ranking_conversion: Subtract the corresponding training gene mean from predictions and truth before selective ranking; never substitute for the primary result.

deep_training.architecture: 6016-500-200-50 expression encoder; 3115-1000-100-50 fingerprint encoder; concatenation then 250-250-1; hidden ReLU, linear output.
deep_training.optimizer: Adam lr=0.001, betas=(0.9,0.999), eps=1e-7; no optimizer search.
deep_training.batch: 500 observed (cell line, target) pairs; uniformly shuffled without replacement each epoch; one optimizer step per batch.
deep_training.pretraining: Reuse the existing non-KIRC 8829-tumor expression autoencoder and verify its hash. No KIRC re-pretraining.
deep_training.validation_rule: No test-based early stopping. Train to maximum or a checkpoint selected exclusively from inner folds for the outer refit.
deep_training.initialization: Reuse the audited encoder; He-uniform for all new linear layers including the output, zero biases; not claimed bit-identical to legacy Keras.

budget.meaning: Maximum assumes all 5 inner fits plus outer refit run 100 epochs, three seeds, all 19 outer lineages. Actual outer epochs may be lower.
budget.runtime_gate: Before full training, measure 20 warmup plus 200 timed GPU updates on the first sorted outer lineage first inner training fold only. Report expected compute cost; do not change model settings based on heldout performance. If the runtime is impractical, record a versioned resource-driven protocol amendment before examining any new heldout model performance; the nominal budget is not an instruction to launch both full runs immediately.
budget.fairness_boundary: Match data, folds, ranking selection and exposure limits; analytic PCR and neural models do not have equal FLOPs or equal search spaces.

evaluation.uncertainty: 20000 paired bootstrap draws by lineage and patient, CUDA, seed 20260921
evaluation.claim_gate: Primary DeepDEP must have a positive paired 95% NDCG interval versus newly fitted PCR; otherwise no superiority claim.
evaluation.external: A positive internal result may motivate a separately frozen Sanger feature-coverage audit; existing restricted-expression Sanger results cannot be relabeled as this comparison.

limitations: Post-hoc development comparison on previously inspected holdouts.
632 expression positions remain imputed; two observed positions duplicate canonical genes.
DepMap release, targets, grouping, pretraining population and checkpoint selection differ from original publication.
Changing features and batching together does not isolate their individual causal effects.
No TCGA KIRC Locked Test access, no patient functional validation.
